title: Canonical affine translation coordinate constructions
statement: For a Noetherian scheme S, a coordinate vector a on affine d-space, and finite coefficients A killed by N, use the canonical coordinate-tower translation isomorphism, its ordered Tate pullback identification, the compact-support exchange, and the normalized twist transport and projective-line datum. These are the explicit constructions in AmbientAffineTranslationTrace; no trace-invariance theorem is part of this definition node.
